content.short: Cronos Accelerator Program is the Web3 ecosystem accelerator of the Cronos chain.
content.description: The Cronos Accelerator Program, now in its second cohort as a three-month program, is scheduled to commence on 24 April 2023. Selected projects will participate in a 12-week acceleration track and receive an upfront seed grant of USD 30,000. Participants will also have the opportunity to secure up to USD 300,000 in additional seed funding from Cronos Labs, and will gain access to mentoring sessions, bespoke masterclasses, and fireside chats with industry experts.
